state: Brent closed near $95.8 on 13 Nov, 3.5% higher on the week but 12.8% lower over a month, inside the $85–110 Watch band and 19% below its 52-week high of $118 (Yahoo Finance). Iran said an LNG carrier hit a mine east of Hormuz on 13 Nov, after claiming four tankers caught fire on 11–12 Nov, keeping supply concerns alive (CBS News). No new outage above 2 mb/d was confirmed this run.
